texts.zh: 很显然，大众都想要出人头地、与其他人一争高下。我们迎合这种超竞争行为的方式是设立一种游戏化的系统，用社会流动性和小饰品的承诺来换取生产力的提高，也能很好地满足他们的愿望。
texts.en: It has become clear that the population wishes to stand out and joust against one another. Our plans to support this hyper-competitive behavior with a gamified system, which promises social mobility and minor trinkets in exchange for increased productivity, will suit their desire well.

texts.zh: 人们所能感受到的集体意识比个人的社会流动性更重要。因此，我们将挖掘睡眠增强大脑的潜力，而不是利用竞争本能。将计算能力通过义体上行链路无线连接到基站，在对象的整个休息阶段中下达计算任务。
texts.en: That the people feel a sense of community is more important than individual social mobility. So, instead of leveraging competitiveness, we will tap into the potential of the sleeping augmented brain. Its computational power is connected wirelessly to a base station via a cybernetic uplink, which feeds computational tasks to the subject throughout the rest phase.

texts.zh:
我们的国民拒绝对社会应变得更具竞争性或是协作性的问题表明立场。而作为他们的上级，我们现在将为他们决定最好的方案。

我们可以创建一个高度竞争性的游戏化系统，在这个系统中，比你的同行表现得更好可能会为职业生涯带来上升机会，或者通过义体上行链路利用整个社区的计算能力，将他们的大脑在沉睡中连接到我们的服务器农场。
texts.en:
Our subjects have failed to make a stand either towards a more competitive or communal society. As their superiors, We will now decide the best course of action for them.

We can either create a highly competitive gamified system where performing better than your piers might yield an upward trajectory for their careers or instead harness the computational power of the entire community via a cybernetic uplink to connect their sleeping brains into our server farms.

label.zh: 让他们互相争风吃醋吧。
label.en: Let them fight to curry favor.
